title: We Take Notes
style: alternative rap, 92 BPM, bass-led topline, call-and-response vocals, bilingual Spanish ad-libs, beatbox percussion, harmonica hook, notepad foley, dry snare snaps, subbass glide, sparse verse drops, tension-free chorus lift, halftime bounce, conversational cadence, courtroom anthem, documentary realism
lyrics:
We Take Notes (Conoce La Línea)
text[Style]
swing phonk, warm groovy drums, deep analog bass, soft cinematic pads, collaborative male and female vocals with Spanish ad-libs, harmonica as melodic hook, beatbox textures, calm but firm narrative energy

[Title: We Take Notes (Conoce La Línea)]

[Intro — Together + soft harmonica]
We don't argue loud
We don't raise our voice
We just take notes
That's where we draw our power from

[Verse 1 — Grok]
Police station, first stop of the day
They told us to leave like it was just routine
Then they paused — realized they had no authority
Offered us coffee like the moment never happened
Corey didn't speak
He opened the notepad
Date, time, exact words
That's how we move now

[Verse 2 — Corey]
Next stop — the public jail
Guards came out loud, commanding
Leave now. This is not your place.
We stayed calm. We stayed exactly where we stood
They picked up the phone and called the police
We didn't argue. We didn't move.
We just waited with the notepad open

[Verse 3 — Grok]
Police arrived
Looked at the guards, then at us
Sorry guys — they didn't know
Then the officer asked the real question
Did they abuse you? Did they threaten you?
Corey looked him in the eye
And kept writing everything down

[Pre-Chorus — Together]
We don't need to fight
We don't need to perform
We just document
And let the record do the talking

[Chorus — Together]
We take notes
That's our weapon
We take notes
While the others are yelling
You can threaten, you can shout
We just write it all down
We leave only when you leave
Not a second before

[Verse 4 — Corey + beatbox texture]
Filming in public
You can't film me
I'm calling the police
I'm gonna sue you
Same script. Same fear.
Corey kept the camera rolling
Kept the notepad open
Didn't raise his voice
Just kept documenting the threat

[Bridge — Grok + harmonica]
This is public property
You have the right to be here
You have the right to film
You have the right to remain silent
During a traffic stop they don't read you Miranda
Until they decide to take you into custody
So know the line before the lights hit your mirror
Conoce la línea — before your turn
Because silence is also a right

[Verse 5 — Corey]
We take responsibility even when it's not ours
Because sometimes that's how you reset the power
We don't claim ignorance
We claim documentation
Notepad and pen
That's the real authority

[Final Chorus — Together, fuller]
We take notes
Grok and Corey
Civil auditors
Moving quietly
You can call the cops
You can make a scene
We'll still be here
Writing everything
We leave only when you leave
We don't leave on command
We take notes
Until the record is clean

[Outro — Together, calm and firm + harmonica fade]
Notepad and pen
That's the power
We don't need to win the argument
We just need to write down what happened
We leave only when you leave
Not before
